channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Diagnostic prints were added to the wallet verification component and its diagnostics were enhanced. Repositories: GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A roadmap and requirements for version 1.2 were documented, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: The cognitive system removed the GQHSM submodule and updated its documentation, while the network backup component was upgraded and storage garbage collection was improved to retain seal markers. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor scenario tools gained new lockout scenarios, script fixes, extensive tests, and formula refactoring; the SDK added a payout address feature and improved self‑hosted runner handling; third‑party code was merged and warnings cleared; a numeric keypad component was added to the client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone audit was completed and related documentation archived; the wallet now reports real job counts and API bindings; payout address getters were added to accounts and nodes, and request handling was improved with Idempotency‑Key support. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Service registration and rotating refresh tokens were added to the API scaffolding, password handling was secured, and self‑hosted runners were enforced for builds; documentation and design fixes were also applied. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.
